tools.name: search
tools.description: Search public WeJob jobs, formations, and companies. Returns ids usable with fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a public WeJob item by id. Supported id prefixes: job:, formation:, company:.

tools.name: wejob_search_jobs
tools.description: Search public active WeJob job offers.

tools.name: wejob_get_job
tools.description: Fetch one public active WeJob job offer by public id (raw id or the job:<id> returned by search/fetch).

tools.name: wejob_get_formation
tools.description: Fetch one public active WeJob formation by public id (raw id or the formation:<id> returned by search/fetch).

tools.name: wejob_get_company
tools.description: Fetch one public WeJob company profile by public id (raw id or the company:<id> returned by search/fetch).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "wejob_get_job" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Fetch one public active WeJob job offer by public id." → after: "Fetch one public active WeJob job offer by public id (raw id or the job:<id> returned by search/fetch)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
